text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. I wonder... how long 
has it been since I last held a plushie?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, do you know about it? The little, 
round fairy in Funabashi.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"I used to take her plushie along with me 
whenever I went on trips."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Looking closely, the Paka Petit is... so 
fluffy and fuzzy...

text_block_list.name: Furioso
choice_data_list: Are you being swayed by the Paka Petit...?

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: N... No. Cute things are cute, that's all.
